name: Over-the-phone interpreter (Indigenous languages, Canada)
summary: Work-from-home phone interpreting between English and Indigenous languages such as Cree or Inuktitut for LanguageLine, as an independent contractor paid per call minute.
whatYouDo: From a quiet home workspace you interpret live phone calls between English speakers and people who speak Cree, Inuktitut or another Indigenous language. You are paid only for the minutes you spend on interpreted calls.
appeal: LanguageLine postings explicitly for work-from-home roles in Canada
Rewards a scarce skill: fluency in Cree, Inuktitut or other Indigenous languages
watchOuts: Independent contractor, not eligible for employee benefits (per posting)
Paid only for active call minutes; reviews report low per-minute pay and periods of low call volume with long unpaid waits
Rates vary by time of day and interpretation level
Must provide a quiet, secure environment
French interpreter postings found were US-only; Canadian postings found were for Indigenous languages
Postings were not opened directly; current openings unconfirmed

training.notes: Training and screening requirements not stated in sources found.

compensation.notes: Per minute of interpreted call time, from aggregator copies (Glassdoor, Remotive) of LanguageLine's Canada postings; currency not shown in indexed text; one copy labels the header 'per hour' but per-minute is consistent across listings. Waiting time between calls is unpaid.

reliability.notes: Glassdoor interpreter reviews (2016–2026, mostly US) are mixed: some report high volume, others falling volume and long waits between short calls. No Canada-specific volume data.

applicationSteps: Find the Canada work-from-home interpreter posting for your language on LanguageLine's Workday careers site
Complete LanguageLine's screening (details not published in sources found)
Set up a quiet, secure home workspace before taking calls
fitsIf: You are fluent in English and an Indigenous language such as Cree or Inuktitut and are comfortable interpreting live calls from home.
notFitIf: You need steady, benefits-eligible hours or are uncomfortable with fast, high-pressure live phone conversations.
